result.reason: The redline improves the Company’s notice period to 30 days and otherwise preserves the annual renewal structure, but it does not reach either playbook position because it adds no price-increase cap. It also omits the 60-day renewal reminder required by the preferred position, and HDI’s 90-day notice period exceeds the fallback’s stated 60-day maximum if that maximum applies to either party. In addition, the clause is framed as termination on a specified date rather than clearly as non-renewal effective at the end of the then-current term.
